target.rawSql: SELECT occurred_at AS time, COALESCE(resolved_at, NOW()) AS timeend, message AS text, kind AS tags FROM alarms WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at);

SELECT d.opened_at AS time, COALESCE(d.closed_at, NOW()) AS timeend, CONCAT(t.full_name, ' · ', d.access_method) AS text, d.event_type AS tags FROM door_events AS d JOIN technicians AS t ON t.id = d.operator_id WHERE d.incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(d.opened_at);

description: Historial de la incubadora SmartEgg guardado en PostgreSQL.

links.title: SmartEgg · Tiempo real
links.tooltip: Dashboard alimentado por el broker MQTT

panels.description: Conexión del nodo según el backend. Pasa a «Sin conexión» si no reporta hace más de 2 minutos.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN is_online AND last_seen_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '2 minutes' THEN 'online' ELSE 'offline' END AS "Estado" FROM incubators WHERE id = ${incubator_id};

panels.title: Estado del nodo

panels.description: Promedio del rango con la tendencia de fondo. Verde dentro del rango óptimo 37 – 38 °C.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(recorded_at, $__interval), AVG(temperature_c) AS "Temperatura" FROM telemetry_readings WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Temperatura promedio

panels.description: Promedio del rango con la tendencia de fondo. Verde dentro del rango óptimo 50 – 65 %.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(recorded_at, $__interval), AVG(humidity_pct) AS "Humedad" FROM telemetry_readings WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Humedad promedio

panels.description: Porcentaje de lecturas con temperatura y humedad dentro de los límites configurados para la incubadora.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN t.temperature_c BETWEEN c.temperature_min_c AND c.temperature_max_c AND t.humidity_pct BETWEEN c.humidity_min_pct AND c.humidity_max_pct THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "En rango" FROM telemetry_readings AS t JOIN incubator_configs AS c ON c.incubator_id = t.incubator_id WHERE t.incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(t.recorded_at);

panels.title: Tiempo en rango óptimo

panels.description: Lecturas guardadas en PostgreSQL durante el rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(recorded_at, $__interval), COUNT(*) AS "Muestras" FROM telemetry_readings WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Muestras registradas

panels.description: Alarmas del nodo que todavía no se resuelven, sin importar el rango de tiempo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Alarmas activas" FROM alarms WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND resolved_at IS NULL;

panels.title: Alarmas activas

panels.description: Línea: promedio por intervalo. Sombra: mínimo y máximo del intervalo. Banda verde: rango óptimo 37 – 38 °C. Zona roja: crítico desde 39 °C. Las regiones rojas y naranjas sobre la gráfica son alarmas y aperturas de puerta.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(recorded_at, $__interval, NULL), AVG(temperature_c) AS "Temperatura", MIN(temperature_c) AS "Mínima", MAX(temperature_c) AS "Máxima" FROM telemetry_readings WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Temperatura · promedio y rango por intervalo

panels.description: Distribución de las lecturas según los límites configurados: baja, óptima, alta y crítica.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * AVG((t.temperature_c < c.temperature_min_c)::int) AS "Baja", 100.0 * AVG((t.temperature_c BETWEEN c.temperature_min_c AND c.temperature_max_c)::int) AS "Óptima", 100.0 * AVG((t.temperature_c > c.temperature_max_c AND t.temperature_c < c.critical_temperature_c)::int) AS "Alta", 100.0 * AVG((t.temperature_c >= c.critical_temperature_c)::int) AS "Crítica" FROM telemetry_readings AS t JOIN incubator_configs AS c ON c.incubator_id = t.incubator_id WHERE t.incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(t.recorded_at);

panels.title: Tiempo por zona térmica

panels.description: Línea: promedio por intervalo. Sombra: mínimo y máximo del intervalo. Banda verde: rango óptimo 50 – 65 %.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(recorded_at, $__interval, NULL), AVG(humidity_pct) AS "Humedad", MIN(humidity_pct) AS "Mínima", MAX(humidity_pct) AS "Máxima" FROM telemetry_readings WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Humedad · promedio y rango por intervalo

panels.description: Distribución de las lecturas según los límites configurados: baja, óptima y alta.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * AVG((t.humidity_pct < c.humidity_min_pct)::int) AS "Baja", 100.0 * AVG((t.humidity_pct BETWEEN c.humidity_min_pct AND c.humidity_max_pct)::int) AS "Óptima", 100.0 * AVG((t.humidity_pct > c.humidity_max_pct)::int) AS "Alta" FROM telemetry_readings AS t JOIN incubator_configs AS c ON c.incubator_id = t.incubator_id WHERE t.incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(t.recorded_at);

panels.title: Tiempo por zona de humedad

panels.description: Estado de la cámara en cada intervalo: zona de temperatura y humedad, puerta, lectura del DHT11 y sistema habilitado. Los huecos son intervalos sin lecturas.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(t.recorded_at, $__interval, NULL), CASE WHEN AVG(t.temperature_c) >= MIN(c.critical_temperature_c) THEN 'Crítica' WHEN AVG(t.temperature_c) > MIN(c.temperature_max_c) THEN 'Alta' WHEN AVG(t.temperature_c) < MIN(c.temperature_min_c) THEN 'Baja' ELSE 'Óptima' END AS "Temperatura", CASE WHEN AVG(t.humidity_pct) > MIN(c.humidity_max_pct) THEN 'Alta' WHEN AVG(t.humidity_pct) < MIN(c.humidity_min_pct) THEN 'Baja' ELSE 'Óptima' END AS "Humedad", CASE WHEN BOOL_OR(COALESCE(t.door_open, FALSE)) THEN 'Abierta' ELSE 'Cerrada' END AS "Puerta", CASE WHEN BOOL_AND(COALESCE(t.sensor_ok, TRUE)) THEN 'OK' ELSE 'Falla' END AS "Sensor DHT11", CASE WHEN BOOL_AND(COALESCE(t.system_enabled, TRUE)) THEN 'Activo' ELSE 'Pausado' END AS "Sistema" FROM telemetry_readings AS t JOIN incubator_configs AS c ON c.incubator_id = t.incubator_id WHERE t.incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(t.recorded_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Línea de tiempo de la cámara

panels.description: Posiciones ocupadas respecto a la capacidad según la última lectura del rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * occupied_slots / NULLIF(occupied_slots + available_slots, 0) AS "Ocupación" FROM telemetry_readings WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1;

panels.title: Ocupación de la cámara

panels.description: Posiciones reportadas por el nodo, apiladas hasta la capacidad total.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(recorded_at, $__interval, NULL), MAX(occupied_slots) AS "Ocupadas", MIN(available_slots) AS "Disponibles" FROM telemetry_readings WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Posiciones ocupadas y disponibles

panels.description: Movimientos del servomotor agrupados por intervalo. La leyenda suma el total del rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(performed_at, $__interval, 0), COUNT(*) AS "Rotaciones" FROM rotation_events WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(performed_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Rotaciones de bandeja

panels.description: Momento de la lectura más reciente guardada para el nodo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(recorded_at)) * 1000 AS "Última lectura" FROM telemetry_readings WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id};

panels.title: Última lectura

panels.description: Huevos del nodo con estado «incubando».

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Huevos" FROM eggs WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND status = 'incubating';

panels.title: Huevos en incubación

panels.description: Temperatura mientras al menos un huevo del lote seleccionado estuvo dentro de la incubadora.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MIN(t.temperature_c) AS "Mínima", AVG(t.temperature_c) AS "Promedio", MAX(t.temperature_c) AS "Máxima" FROM telemetry_readings AS t WHERE t.incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(t.recorded_at) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM eggs AS e WHERE e.lot_id = NULLIF('${lot_id}', '')::int AND e.incubator_id = t.incubator_id AND t.recorded_at >= e.registered_at AND (e.ended_at IS NULL OR t.recorded_at <= e.ended_at));

panels.title: Lote ${lot_id:text} · Temperatura

panels.description: Humedad mientras al menos un huevo del lote seleccionado estuvo dentro de la incubadora.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MIN(t.humidity_pct) AS "Mínima", AVG(t.humidity_pct) AS "Promedio", MAX(t.humidity_pct) AS "Máxima" FROM telemetry_readings AS t WHERE t.incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(t.recorded_at) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM eggs AS e WHERE e.lot_id = NULLIF('${lot_id}', '')::int AND e.incubator_id = t.incubator_id AND t.recorded_at >= e.registered_at AND (e.ended_at IS NULL OR t.recorded_at <= e.ended_at));

panels.title: Lote ${lot_id:text} · Humedad

panels.description: Temperatura durante la permanencia del huevo seleccionado en la incubadora.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MIN(t.temperature_c) AS "Mínima", AVG(t.temperature_c) AS "Promedio", MAX(t.temperature_c) AS "Máxima" FROM telemetry_readings AS t JOIN eggs AS e ON e.id = NULLIF('${egg_id}', '')::int AND e.incubator_id = t.incubator_id AND t.recorded_at >= e.registered_at AND (e.ended_at IS NULL OR t.recorded_at <= e.ended_at) WHERE t.incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(t.recorded_at);

panels.title: Huevo ${egg_id:text} · Temperatura

panels.description: Humedad durante la permanencia del huevo seleccionado en la incubadora.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MIN(t.humidity_pct) AS "Mínima", AVG(t.humidity_pct) AS "Promedio", MAX(t.humidity_pct) AS "Máxima" FROM telemetry_readings AS t JOIN eggs AS e ON e.id = NULLIF('${egg_id}', '')::int AND e.incubator_id = t.incubator_id AND t.recorded_at >= e.registered_at AND (e.ended_at IS NULL OR t.recorded_at <= e.ended_at) WHERE t.incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(t.recorded_at);

panels.title: Huevo ${egg_id:text} · Humedad

panels.description: Agregados de cada lote que estuvo en la incubadora durante el rango, con el avance de la incubación hasta la fecha estimada de eclosión.

targets.rawSql: SELECT l.code AS "Lote", l.species AS "Especie", l.status AS "Estado", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eggs AS e2 WHERE e2.lot_id = l.id AND e2.incubator_id = ${incubator_id}) AS "Huevos", LEAST(100, GREATEST(0, 100.0 * (CURRENT_DATE - l.started_on) / NULLIF(l.expected_hatch_on - l.started_on, 0))) AS "Avance", MIN(t.temperature_c) AS "T. mín", AVG(t.temperature_c) AS "T. prom", MAX(t.temperature_c) AS "T. máx", MIN(t.humidity_pct) AS "H. mín", AVG(t.humidity_pct) AS "H. prom", MAX(t.humidity_pct) AS "H. máx" FROM lots AS l JOIN telemetry_readings AS t ON t.incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM eggs AS e WHERE e.lot_id = l.id AND e.incubator_id = t.incubator_id AND t.recorded_at >= e.registered_at AND (e.ended_at IS NULL OR t.recorded_at <= e.ended_at)) WHERE $__timeFilter(t.recorded_at) GROUP BY l.id, l.code, l.species, l.status, l.started_on, l.expected_hatch_on ORDER BY l.code;

panels.title: Resumen por lote

panels.description: Aperturas de puerta registradas en el rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(opened_at, $__interval, 0), COUNT(*) AS "Aperturas" FROM door_events WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(opened_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Aperturas

panels.description: Cierres confirmados por el final de carrera en el rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Cierres" FROM door_events WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(closed_at);

panels.title: Cierres

panels.description: Duración promedio de cada apertura cerrada en el rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (closed_at - opened_at))) AS "Duración" FROM door_events WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(opened_at) AND closed_at IS NOT NULL;

panels.title: Tiempo medio abierta

panels.description: Suma de huevos que entraron durante las aperturas del rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(eggs_added), 0) AS "Ingresados" FROM door_events WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(opened_at);

panels.title: Huevos ingresados

panels.description: Suma de huevos que salieron durante las aperturas del rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(eggs_removed), 0) AS "Retirados" FROM door_events WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(opened_at);

panels.title: Huevos retirados

panels.description: Operadores distintos que abrieron la puerta en el rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT operator_id) AS "Operadores" FROM door_events WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(opened_at);

panels.title: Operadores activos

panels.description: Aperturas registradas por cada operador en el rango seleccionado.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.full_name AS "Operador", COUNT(*) AS "Aperturas" FROM door_events AS d JOIN technicians AS t ON t.id = d.operator_id WHERE d.incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(d.opened_at) GROUP BY t.full_name ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Aperturas por operador

panels.description: Credencial usada para abrir la puerta: tarjeta RFID, huella, llave o contraseña.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE d.access_method WHEN 'rfid' THEN 'Tarjeta RFID' WHEN 'fingerprint' THEN 'Huella' WHEN 'key' THEN 'Llave' ELSE 'Contraseña' END AS "Método", COUNT(*) AS "Aperturas" FROM door_events AS d WHERE d.incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(d.opened_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Método de acceso

panels.description: Motivo registrado para cada apertura de la puerta.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE d.event_type WHEN 'egg_entry' THEN 'Ingreso de huevos' WHEN 'egg_removal' THEN 'Retiro de huevos' WHEN 'inspection' THEN 'Inspección' ELSE 'Mantenimiento' END AS "Operación", COUNT(*) AS "Aperturas" FROM door_events AS d WHERE d.incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(d.opened_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Tipo de operación

panels.description: Auditoría de aperturas: quién abrió, con qué credencial, cuántos huevos movió y cuánto tiempo estuvo abierta la puerta. Se filtra con la variable Operador.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.opened_at AS "Fecha", t.full_name AS "Operador", t.role AS "Rol", d.event_type AS "Operación", d.access_method AS "Método", d.eggs_added AS "Ingresados", d.eggs_removed AS "Retirados", CASE WHEN d.closed_at IS NULL THEN 'Abierta' ELSE 'Cerrada' END AS "Puerta", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(d.closed_at, NOW()) - d.opened_at)) AS "Duración" FROM door_events AS d JOIN technicians AS t ON t.id = d.operator_id WHERE d.incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND (NULLIF('${operator_id}', '0') IS NULL OR d.operator_id = NULLIF('${operator_id}', '')::int) AND $__timeFilter(d.opened_at) ORDER BY d.opened_at DESC LIMIT 200;

panels.title: Operaciones de puerta

panels.description: Alarmas que se dispararon durante el rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, $__interval, 0), COUNT(*) AS "Alarmas" FROM alarms WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Alarmas en el rango

panels.description: Alarmas con severidad crítica durante el rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Críticas" FROM alarms WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND severity = 'critical';

panels.title: Críticas

panels.description: Promedio entre que se dispara y se resuelve cada alarma del rango.

targets.rawSql: SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (resolved_at - occurred_at))) AS "MTTR" FROM alarms WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL;

panels.title: Tiempo medio de resolución

panels.description: Porcentaje de alarmas del rango que un operador reconoció.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * AVG((acknowledged_at IS NOT NULL)::int) AS "Reconocidas" FROM alarms WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at);

panels.title: Reconocidas

panels.description: Cantidad de alarmas por condición en el rango seleccionado.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE kind WHEN 'temperature_low' THEN 'Temperatura baja' WHEN 'temperature_high' THEN 'Temperatura alta' WHEN 'humidity_low' THEN 'Humedad baja' WHEN 'humidity_high' THEN 'Humedad alta' ELSE kind END AS "Tipo", COUNT(*) AS "Eventos" FROM alarms WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

panels.title: Alarmas por tipo

panels.description: Cada condición con su severidad, estado y la duración que estuvo activa.

targets.rawSql: SELECT occurred_at AS "Fecha", kind AS "Tipo", severity AS "Severidad", CASE WHEN resolved_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Resuelta' WHEN acknowledged_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'Reconocida' ELSE 'Activa' END AS "Estado", message AS "Mensaje", value AS "Valor", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(resolved_at, NOW()) - occurred_at)) AS "Duración" FROM alarms WHERE incubator_id = ${incubator_id} AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100;
